name: receipts
description: Receipts — tailor every application, invent nothing. An Anna App that checks a job posting against your CV line by line.

scripts.test:engine: cd executas/receipts-engine && uv run --extra dev pytest ../../tests -q
scripts.lint:engine: cd executas/receipts-engine && uv run --extra dev ruff check . && uv run --extra dev mypy receipts_engine
scripts.eval: cd executas/receipts-engine && uv run --extra dev python ../../scripts/eval_match.py ../../fixtures/golden
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:engine && pnpm validate
